@graph.name: Miami-Dade County 5000 Addresses Normalized (Random)
@graph.description: A set of 5000 random addresses in Miami-Dade County.

additionalProperty.name: process_step
additionalProperty.value:
#########
  # GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
  # and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
  ####
  
  #########
  # Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
  ####
  
  # create directory structure and move into it
  mkdir -p /data/mdc_5000_addresses_normalized/download -p /data/mdc_5000_addresses_normalized/etl
  chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_5000_addresses_normalized
  cd /data/mdc_5000_addresses_normalized
  
  # set update flag based on last update and update frequency
  do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1
  
  # remove spaces, periods, and leading numerical digits in column headers (if needed)
    if (head -n 1 download/mdc_5000_addresses_normalized.csv | grep -qE '\s|\.|\"[0-9]'); then
      sed -i '1s/ /_/g; 1s/\.//g; 1s/\"\([0-9]\)/\"n\1/g' download/mdc_5000_addresses_normalized.csv 2>&1
    fi
  
  # load into postGIS with:
  ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/mdc_5000_addresses_normalized.csv -oo X_POSSIBLE_NAMES=x_coord -oo Y_POSSIBLE_NAMES=y_coord -s_srs EPSG:2236 -t_srs EPSG:4326 -nlt point -nln mdc_5000_addresses_normalized
  echo success: mdc_5000_addresses_normalized.csv loaded with ogr2ogr
  
  
  #########
  # Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
  ####
  
  # remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
  UPDATE mdc_5000_addresses_normalized
    SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));
  
  # add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
  ALTER TABLE mdc_5000_addresses_normalized DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
  SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
    'mdc_5000_addresses_normalized',
    'geom_local', 2236, 'point', 2
  );
  UPDATE mdc_5000_addresses_normalized
    SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(geom,2236)));
  CREATE INDEX mdc_5000_addresses_normalized_geom_local_idx
    ON mdc_5000_addresses_normalized
    USING GIST (geom_local);
  NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
